facts.description:
View 2814 West 3rd Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6K 1M7, CA rent availability, including the monthly rent price, and browse photos of this 3 beds, 1 bath, 1,050 sqft apartment. 2814 West 3rd Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6K 1M7, CA offers studio, 1 bedroom, 2 bedroom and 3+ bedroom apartments for rent or lease. There is currently 1 unit listed for rent at 2814 West 3rd Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6K 1M7, CA.
Special summer monthly promotion during FIFA World Cup.

In the heart of Kitsilano two blocks from the beach.  Great central location- 8 minutes to downtown, 10 minutes to UBC and a short walk to parks, tennis courts, restaurants and shops, this Vancouver Craftsman style home is beautifully maintained with exquisite furnished suites.  This is not a high-rise apartment.
This large 3 bedroom apartment is conveniently located on the garden level and features west facing covered outdoor deck with dining furniture and private yard.  The apartment has a new kitchen with granite counters, new appliances and all crockery.  The living room has a lovely leather sofa, 46" flat screen TV, fireplace and hardwood floors.  There is a full bathroom newly renovated with heated tile floors, shower and bath.
All three bedrooms have queen beds with high end 400 thread count sheets.
Opposite the home is beautiful Tatlow Park with children's playground, tennis courts and a short walk to the beach.
Laundry facilities in building.


NOTE:  Our Vancouver furnished apartments are located in a modernized character home with a touch of 1912 class just 2 blocks from the ocean.

Many of our guests, who book our furnished suites in Vancouver, include visiting professors at UBC, doctors here for sabbatical and exchange programs at Vancouver General Hospital (VGH), St. Paul’s and UBC hospital, business people here for extended contracts, parents of university students living in student accommodation, parents of children about to have their first baby, wedding guests, pre and post cruise guests, returning Vancouver residents, new immigrants, people undergoing renovations or insurance claims, patients and their families under going medical treatment…..and vacationers of all ages.

Come stay with us at Alma Beach Suites, your home away from home! We look forward to making your stay with us a memorable one as you explore beautiful Vancouver!
